VisuStella does, in fact, have a series of plugins to give you several choices of styles for all of those screens, with plugin parameters to modify some of it further via JavaScript.
But aside from that, I don't know that there's anything to do other than learn where the coordinates and shapes of the windows are defined in the code and make a plugin.
Or use the commission section of the forum to have someone do it for you.

posts.author: ISC
posts.body:
Visustella's Battle Core is just a foundation that adds new mechanics to the default system. There are other systems that further extend the ways you can customize the battle screen and its functionalities, but most of them are paid. It's worth noting that these systems focus more on introducing new features and mechanics rather than on the HUD. The systems that connect to the Battle Core are:
ATB, BTB, CTB, FTB, OTB, PTB, STB.
Each of these systems focuses on different graphical and mechanical aspects.
